+          for p in patches/*.patch; do git -C "$src" apply --recount --check "$PWD/$p"; git -C "$src" apply --recount "$PWD/$p"; done
+      - name: Install pinned Cloudron CLI
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          registry_integrity="$(npm view "cloudron@${CLOUDRON_CLI_VERSION}" dist.integrity)"
+          test "${registry_integrity}" = "${CLOUDRON_CLI_INTEGRITY}"
+          npm install --global --ignore-scripts "cloudron@${CLOUDRON_CLI_VERSION}"
+          test "$(cloudron --version)" = "${CLOUDRON_CLI_VERSION}"
+      - name: Dry-run catalog entry with the real Cloudron CLI
+        # Runs the real manifest and file:// reference parsing on a scratch
+        # copy of the catalog so errors fail the PR, not publication.

+          if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" != pull_request && "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/heads/main && "$PUBLICATION_ENABLED" == true ]]; then

+        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE"
+      - uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
+        with:
+          registry: ghcr.io
+          username: ${{ github.actor }}
+          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1
+      - uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
+        id: build

+        with:

+          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
+          push-to-registry: true
